references.text: The introduction to the seven days of the Feast of Tabernacles, describing the pattern of offerings followed throughout the festival.
The entire section on the seven days of the Feast of Tabernacles, where the number of bulls decreases each day from thirteen down to seven on the seventh day.
The requirement that the sacrificial animals must be without blemish (תְּמִימִם), which is also mentioned in this verse.
Basic instructions about the Feast of Tabernacles in Leviticus, lasting for seven days.
Deuteronomy's command to celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles for seven days.
Ezra's restoration of the Feast of Tabernacles with the daily burnt offerings as prescribed.
Ezekiel's prophetic vision concerning the Feast of Tabernacles and its sacrifices in the future temple.
